name: FarDriver Protection, PID, and Factory Settings
description: Protection, temperature, battery, PID, field-weakening, and factory parameters from the public manual. Several temperature and voltage thresholds below are now confirmed from the official Xamarin APK register decode.

settings.label: Protect Voltage
settings.description: Primary low-voltage protection threshold. Official app decodes `(arg[5]*256 + arg[4]) / 10` from register 30.

settings.label: Recover Voltage
settings.description: Voltage threshold to resume after low-voltage protection. Official app derives this as low-voltage protect plus 2.0V.

settings.label: Charge Protect Voltage
settings.description: High-voltage / charge protection threshold. Official app decodes `(arg[5]*256 + arg[4]) / 10` from register 36.

settings.label: Battery Signal Source
settings.description: Where battery state is sourced from.

settings.label: Battery Power Factor
settings.description: Battery power derating factor.

settings.label: Battery Current Correction
settings.description: Calibration factor for battery current.

settings.label: Battery Overcurrent Protect
settings.description: Battery over-current protection threshold.

settings.label: SOC Power Reduction Start
settings.description: SOC at which power reduction begins.

settings.label: SOC Power Reduction End
settings.description: SOC at which the reduction curve reaches minimum power.

settings.label: Motor Temp Protect
settings.description: Motor over-temperature cutback or trip point. Official app reads `arg[6]` from register 130.

settings.label: Motor Temp Recover
settings.description: Motor temperature resume point. Official app reads `arg[7]` from register 130.

settings.label: Controller Temp Protect
settings.description: Controller/MOS temperature protection threshold. Official app reads `arg[8]` from register 130.

settings.label: Controller Temp Recover
settings.description: Controller/MOS temperature recovery threshold. Official app reads `arg[9]` from register 130.

settings.label: Temperature Coefficient
settings.description: Temperature compensation coefficient. Official app decodes this from register 99 `(arg[9]*256 + arg[8])`.

settings.label: Lost Throttle Alarm
settings.description: Alarm behavior when throttle is lost.

settings.label: Throttle Plug Protection
settings.description: Protection against unplugged or invalid throttle sensor.

settings.label: Reverse Enable
settings.description: Enable reverse function.

settings.label: Seat Bucket Delay
settings.description: Delay related to seat-bucket logic from the manual.

settings.label: Parking Delay
settings.description: Delay before entering parking state.

settings.label: Cruise Enable
settings.description: Enable or disable cruise function.

settings.label: Boost Enable
settings.description: Enable or disable boost mode.

settings.label: PID1
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID2
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID3
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID4
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID5
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID6
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID7
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: PID8
settings.description: PID-related tuning value from the manual.

settings.label: Field Weakening Start
settings.description: Start RPM for field weakening.

settings.label: Field Weakening Max
settings.description: Maximum field weakening level.

settings.label: Field Weakening Response
settings.description: Response or gain for field weakening.

settings.label: Deep Weak Mode
settings.description: Deep weak-magnet program / mode.

settings.label: Factory Program Code
settings.description: Composite special program code value.

settings.label: Hardware Version
settings.description: Hardware version letter or code.

settings.label: Extension Code
settings.description: Encoder / variant extension code.

settings.label: Isolation Program
settings.description: Program bit indicating isolated hardware.

settings.label: 120M High-Speed Version
settings.description: Program bit indicating 120M high-speed version.
